items.text: Wait synchronously for an incoming message. Replaces client-side polling; available in all SDKs as messages.wait().
Use Message.headers and content instead. Removed in v2.
Listing inboxes is deprecated in favour of waiting for messages; a cursor parameter was added for the transition.
Now uses RFC 3339 with a Z suffix. Previously returned a Unix timestamp in v1.
Version 2 authenticates with bearer tokens; the X-Api-Key header of version 1 is retired.

summary: API and SDK changes for version 2. Breaking changes ship only in a new major version.
